answer: Each identity must complete verified trades with 40 independent counterparties per epoch, logged on a public atlas; a timber lot moves only when a walnut-shell escrow releases payment on delivery. A counterparty met twice counts once, so self-dealing rings collapse to one. Forging 1,000 identities needs 40,000 trades at 6 credits each: 240,000 in all. One address serving fifty fakes flags the whole ring. An honest agent trades 40 times once.
